answer_1.quote: We test zero-shot code understanding on CodeXGLUE docstring generation task, which requires models to generate a docstring description given the function code as the prompt...we also benchmark the instruction following ability of our models using the HumanEvalFixDocs task...we evaluate on the Commit Chronicle commit message generation task.
answer_1.outputs: code snippets, generated docstrings, commit messages, fixed code solutions

answer_2.quote: We measure the performance with Smoothed BLEU-4 scores...we report the performance in terms of ROUGE-2 and ROUGE-L...we report pass@1, pass@10, and pass@25 metrics on Multipl‑E and HumanEvalFixDocs.
